market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance is one of the world's most valuable private companies, with a valuation likely exceeding $200B. While the exact timing of an IPO is uncertain, the 2026 window is far enough out that a listing is plausible (I estimate ~5% probability), especially with regulatory pressure on TikTok potentially forcing a public spin-off. If ByteDance does IPO, it would almost certainly top the 2026 IPO market-cap rankings given its scale and the scarcity of comparable private behemoths likely to go public that year. The market-implied 0.1% chance is an order of magnitude too low.
evidence_points: ByteDance's estimated valuation ($200B+) makes it a dominant contender for the largest IPO in any year it chooses to list.
Regulatory timelines (e.g., US TikTok divestment law) may force ByteDance to restructure or IPO parts of its business by 2026.
Historical IPO market data shows few companies are large enough to surpass a ByteDance debut, reducing competition risk.
sources_consulted: Public estimates of ByteDance valuation (e.g., PitchBook, CB Insights)
News reports on ByteDance IPO speculation and TikTok regulatory developments
General knowledge of the 2021–2023 IPO pipeline for large private companies
